support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Need help? We're here for you.
support.cardFaqDesc: Find answers to the most common questions about Aplifyr.
support.cardContactDesc: Send us a message and we'll reply within 24 hours.
support.faq1a: Aplifyr analyses your profile and compares it against job listings to give you a grade (A, B or C) based on how well you match.
support.faq2q: How do I add a new job?
support.faq2a: Go to the All Jobs page and use the upload feature to add a job listing manually or via a link.
support.faq3q: Can I change the app language?
support.faq3a: Yes! Click the language switcher (EN/SV) at the bottom of the sidebar to toggle between English and Swedish.
support.faq4q: How do I remove a job from the list?
support.faq4a: Open the job and select Remove. The job will be deleted from your list immediately.
support.formSuccessDesc: We'll get back to you within 24 hours.
